abstract: A radioimmunoassay system for the glycoprotein beta 1SP1, one of the pregnancy-associated proteins, has been set up. beta 1SP1 levels in normal pregnancy have been established transversally. Clearance (t1/2) from the circulation postpartum ranged from 1.4 to 1.8 days. Several patients with trophoblastic disease, e.g., mola hydatidosa, choriocarcinoma and embryonic cell carcinoma, were followed longitudinally. Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), a highly reliable tumor marker in trophoblastic disease, has been determined concomitantly by radioimmunoassay. In all instances, hCG proved to be a better indicator of the presence of a tumor, because by the time beta 1SP1 became undetectable, hCG could still be detected. Samples from a large multicenter study on trophoblastic disease were studied: out of 100 positive for hCG, beta 1SP1 could be detected in 86; however, out of 21 samples in which hCG was not detectable, 1 was found to be positive for beta 1SP1. In a number of samples from patients with bronchial carcinoma, no beta 1SP1 could be detected.
abstract_ja: 妊娠関連糖タンパクであるβ1SP1に対する放射免疫測定系を確立した。正常妊娠におけるβ1SP1の値を横断的に求めた。産褥期の循環からのクリアランス(半減期 t1/2)は1.4〜1.8日であった。胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胚性癌細胞癌などの絨毛性疾患の患者数名について縦断的に追跡した。絨毛性疾患における信頼性の高い腫瘍マーカーであるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を、同時に放射免疫測定法で測定した。いずれの症例でも、β1SP1が検出されなくなった時点でも、hCGはなお検出可能であり、腫瘍の存在をより良く示す指標であった。絨毛性疾患の大規模多施設共同研究の検体を調べた。hCG陽性の100検体のうち86検体でβ1SP1が検出された。一方、hCGが検出されなかった21検体のうち1検体のみがβ1SP1陽性であった。気管支癌の多くの検体ではβ1SP1は検出されなかった。
